properties.name: descriptor
properties.comment: The flags enumeration the editor offers; a view, since the form properties rebuild it. It must be a valid flags descriptor with at least one positive single-bit choice that can represent the current value (std::invalid_argument otherwise); a change normalizes the value and reopens an open list.
hand: a view onto descriptor_ beside value_; write_view validates, normalizes the value and reopens the list

properties.name: value
properties.comment: The checked flags, normalized against descriptor; a view, since the list's checks move it. A value the descriptor cannot represent throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: a view onto value_, which the overlay's checks move; write_view normalizes and synchronizes the open list

properties.name: dropped_down
properties.comment: Whether the list of flags is open; a view, since the list closes itself. A write opens or closes it and raises drop_down_changed.
hand: a view onto dropped_down_; write_view opens or closes the list

properties.name: overlay_width
properties.comment: The width of the list of flags, 80 to 1024 (std::invalid_argument otherwise); a change reopens an open list.
hand: prepare validates; written reopens an open list

not_properties.name: enumeration_name, flag_names, none_name, checked_flags
not_properties.reason: form properties in the control's own table that rebuild descriptor and value together
